name: seederpro
description: Open-source recruitment pipeline with transparent scoring and self-hostable infrastructure.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev --workspace @seederpro/api" "npm run dev --workspace @seederpro/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @seederpro/core && npm run build --workspace @seederpro/api && npm run build --workspace @seederpro/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @seederpro/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @seederpro/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @seederpro/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @seederpro/core && npm run lint --workspace @seederpro/api && npm run lint --workspace @seederpro/web
scripts.prechallenge:rank: npm run build --workspace @seederpro/core && npm run build --workspace @seederpro/api
